title: Inn - Rest a While
_note: Game-wide INN / rest-point interior cue. snes register, small room: 5 voices, no drums. 90 BPM, 3/4, F major - settled and contented (contrast tinderwick-b's homesick 6/8 A-minor lullaby). The low FLUTE sings the Vesper contour as a slow waltz: C4-F4-G4 lift (overshoot) then A4-G4-F4 settle home in bars 1-2. Form AABA, 32 bars (64s): A home, A' turns to C7, B rises warmer through Bb and Am, A'' borrows one minor-iv sigh (Bbm) before the fire settles; last bar C7 leads back. Pluck = soft harp arpeggios; strings = warm low bed; bell = a sleepy music-box glint at phrase ends; tri_bass root then fifth.
